notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline. There are no online trophies on this list.

Names, descriptions and grades match the published PSN trophy list. Guides are written in the author's own words; where no outside guide had confirmed a method at launch, the guide is strategy derived from the official description and is labelled as such.
Only one trophy is reported as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. The game has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.
PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off during a trophy run.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task behind it, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not a trophy to chase directly.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the real time sink: roughly 200 hours to the platinum overall. Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story to see the checklist. PowerPyx reports the checklist is lenient, close to 60% of true completion, so you do not need literally everything: most of it is finished by working through the other trophies, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. Save this for last and let it fill in as you play.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: A grind trophy, not a skill test. Stunts are the game's jump and trick moments: use ramps, jumps and stunt-friendly vehicles while free-roaming, and keep an eye on the Activities tab under Progress to see your count climb. Chip away at it between missions instead of leaving all 250 for the end.

trophies.guide: A sampler trophy. Open Progress, then Activities, to see the nine activity types the tracker counts, and try one of each: a race, a shooting range session, fishing, an arcade game, and so on. You will tick most of them off naturally while chasing the activity trophies, so check the list late in the story and do whatever is left.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Head to the shooting ranges and work through every challenge until each one shows a gold medal. Take it slowly and learn each range's rhythm before going for gold, and use the range's own practice runs to warm up. The gold medals here are not the hardest part of the game, but they do demand steady aim rather than speed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE trophy to watch. PowerPyx flags this as the only potentially missable trophy: the first meditation spot is offered in Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter, and there is no mission replay. Meditate at the Chapter 1 spot the moment it is offered, then meditate at every spot you find as you travel Leonida. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as insurance.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: A long grind: use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. Spread it out across the whole playthrough, hitting a new spot whenever you enter a new area, and the count will climb without ever feeling like a chore. Leaving all 100 for the post-story cleanup is the slow way to do it.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. You only need 50 here, and 70 for the 100% checklist, so skip the challenges you hate: there is room to leave the hardest 10 to 30 alone. Pick the quick ones first and let the count build up.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus during a fight with at least five enemies close together and take all five down before it ends. Pick a busy firefight, wait until enemies cluster, then activate it and work through them quickly. If the group is too spread out, wait for a better moment instead of wasting the activation.
